scenes.narration: This is one cell. The big circle is its nucleus.

steps.say: The nucleus keeps the DNA, the cell's instructions, and sends out copies as messages.
Zoom in on one ribosome, out in the body of the cell, where a message runs through its two halves.
It reads the message and adds one link at a time to a growing protein chain.
Pull back a little, and the nucleus sits far from where the work happens.
And this happens at thousands of ribosomes across the cell at once.

scenes.title: Looking for 42
scenes.narration: Sixteen cards, in no order. We look for forty two one card at a time.

steps.say: Start at the first card. Seven is not it.
Skip ahead past every card we have ruled out.
Here it is, forty two, at index eight.
Pulled back, we checked nine of sixteen cards to find it.
